analysis: Both changed files are test-only. (1) ProviderLoopStreamChunkTests.swift: head lines 59, 282-283, 299, 312 adapt tests to a streaming-delta tool-call type (OpenAIToolCallDelta, optional `function`). No production code is in this batch. The tests still pin the tool_calls hash-domain framing (U+1F markers, sortedKeys determinism) at lines 299-314 and the delta surfacing at 276-283. The related production change (encodeToolCallsForHash taking deltas, hash accumulation of tool-call deltas in ProviderLoop) is not supplied, so whether the attestation response-hash domain (TB-007/T-007) stays equivalent for partial or fragmented tool-call deltas cannot be verified here; the production counterpart should be checked. (2) LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift (patch, head 181-204): new test asserting that LaunchAgent.passthroughEnvironment forwards only the prefill-chunk and step-token-budget env keys (EngineV2Factory.prefillChunkKey/stepTokenBudgetKey) and drops unrelated variables (UNRELATED_SECRET excluded), and that WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys does not contain them. This is an allowlist-style test and reinforces the env-leak control. The production allowlist change is not in this batch. These are tuning knobs, not secrets, and do not touch the prefix-cache gating or TTL (T-041). No security regressions are identifiable from the supplied test-only changes. Remaining integration question: production side of passthrough allowlist and the tool-call delta hash encoding.
